title: UAAP: La Salle's Tovera, UE's Oñate earn Player of the Week nods
summary: La Salle's Joaquin Tovera continues to prove that he is no ordinary rookie, leading the Green Archers to a crucial victory over their archrivals in the UAAP Season 89 men's basketball tournament.
